title: Billing Finalisation Procedure
content:
SOP: Billing Finalisation Procedure (SOP-BIL-001)
DEPARTMENT: Billing
VERSION: 3.0
ROLES: billing, insurance_tpa
PURPOSE: Consolidated inpatient charge auditing and tax invoice generation.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Billing Finalisation Procedure in full compliance with Billing hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Billing Finalisation Procedure in full compliance with Billing hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Billing Finalisation Procedure in full compliance with Billing hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Billing Finalisation Procedure in full compliance with Billing hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Billing Finalisation Procedure in full compliance with Billing hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Billing Finalisation Procedure in full compliance with Billing hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Billing.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-BIL-001 Billing Finalisation Procedure v3.0, Section 4
